title: Fix training harness warmupSteps default and stale docstring claims
description:
P1: `MemorySmith.Training/harness.py:resolve_hyperparameters` docstring claims `warmup_steps` default is 10 as a deliberate fix for "v7 regression" — but the actual code uses `hp.get("warmupSteps") or 0`, silently falling back to 0. Also the docstring claims `max_train_steps` default is 200, but code uses 75. Two of four "key changes from upstream" claims are wrong.

Consequence: every default-configuration training run gets zero warmup (immediate cosine decay from step 0), which is worse for LoRA fine-tuning quality and likely related to whatever v7 regression motivated the rewrite.

Scope:
- Change `hp.get("warmupSteps") or 0` → `hp.get("warmupSteps") if hp.get("warmupSteps") is not None else 10`
- Fix `max_train_steps` docstring (75, not 200) or vice versa if intended default is different
- Fix the `or`-based fallback pattern: explicit `0` should not be treated as "not provided"
- Consolidate boolean-coercion helpers (duplicated 3×: `include_starter_examples`, `include_transcript_examples`, `resolve_trust_remote_code`)

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-10-20260702.md §1, §2, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md
